meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 把 NanoClaw 分支的个性化改动提取成一份迁移指南;升级时先取干净的上游代码,再按指南把改动重新套回去,避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你说要升级或迁移 NanoClaw 分支、或提到与上游合并出现冲突时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 分支升级到上游最新版
say.note: 会先检查工作区,然后生成迁移指南再重放改动。

say.text: 我的 fork 改了很多,帮我整理一份迁移指南
say.note: 会派子代理分析改动并和你确认意图。

say.text: 已有迁移指南了,直接按它升级
say.note: 检测到指南时可直接跳到升级阶段。

howto.what_en: Extracts a fork's customizations into a migration guide, then upgrades by reapplying those changes on a clean upstream checkout, avoiding merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to upgrade or migrate a NanoClaw fork, or mention merge conflicts with upstream.

say_en.text: Upgrade my NanoClaw fork to the latest upstream.
say_en.note: It checks the working tree, builds a guide, and reapplies changes.

say_en.text: My fork has many changes; help me create a migration guide.
say_en.note: It spawns sub-agents to analyze and confirm intent with you.

say_en.text: I already have a guide; upgrade using it.
say_en.note: If a guide exists, it skips straight to upgrade.
